items.title: Coreline Soft secures FDA clearance for aortic CT software
items.excerpt: Seoul-based Coreline Soft received FDA 510(k) clearance for Aview Aorta Metrics, AI software that automatically segments the aorta on chest CT, classifies aortic zones and measures each zone's diameter. It is the company's 13th FDA clearance.

items.title: SIIM-CAIMI: LLM pipeline tracks critical results in pediatric patients
items.excerpt: Stanford Health built an in-house LLM pipeline that detects critical results in pediatric radiology reports with 99.7% sensitivity and 97.9% specificity and monitors communication turnaround time, replacing costly commercial tools (SIIM-CAIMI 2026).

items.title: AI fails to compensate for night-shift fatigue among residents
items.excerpt: Radiology residents' chest x-ray accuracy fell significantly after overnight shifts, and AI assistance neither restored pre-shift performance nor meaningfully improved fatigued readers' accuracy, raising patient-safety concerns.

items.title: Pennsylvania House passes bill requiring AI disclosure in healthcare
items.excerpt: If enacted, the legislation would require healthcare facilities, including imaging centers, to disclose their use of AI in clinical decision-making through website postings and written patient notifications.

items.title: AI matches radiologists at prostate cancer detection via MRI
items.excerpt: New research suggests AI performs on par with radiologists at detecting prostate cancer on MRI across diverse patient datasets, which authors say could substantially widen access to prostate cancer diagnostics.

items.title: Radiology societies weigh in on FDA’s push to regulate generative AI
items.excerpt: “Patient safety should remain the central organizing principle, and regulatory flexibility should be paired with clear, enforceable safeguards," RSNA said in recently shared comments.

items.title: AI tech detects high-risk coronary inflammation in many asymptomatic patients
items.excerpt: The first U.S. study of Caristo's FDA-cleared CaRi-Heart AI found about 47% of asymptomatic adults with no detectable coronary plaque had elevated perivascular inflammation on cardiac CT, questioning standard risk assessment tools.

items.title: Clinicians from all specialties use AI to answer cardiology questions
items.excerpt: More than 950,000 clinicians submitted queries to a popular AI platform from January 2024 to June 2026; cardiovascular care was a common topic, especially questions about specific treatments.

items.title: AI Scribes Improved Note-Taking Time but Not Productivity, Study Finds
items.excerpt: After clinicians enrolled in the Heidi ambient scribe at Beth Israel Deaconess, median note-active time fell from 21 to 18.6 minutes, but there was no change in same-day or after-hours note closure or clinical productivity (Annals of Internal Medicine).

items.title: Systemwide adoption patterns of ambient AI scribe technology in an integrated academic health system
items.excerpt: A retrospective cohort study of 2,901 ambulatory clinicians examines who adopted ambient AI scribes, and how intensively, during an enterprise-scale rollout at an integrated academic health system.

items.title: AI doctors' orders come with a sky-high bill
items.excerpt: Large language models suggest more tests, referrals and medications than human physicians do, driving up the cost of care (on a NEJM AI study comparing LLM- and physician-recommended care).

items.title: Putting conversational AI to the test in primary care
items.excerpt: A patient-facing conversational AI showed promising feasibility and safety in a single-center primary care setting, providing a basis for larger-scale evaluation.

items.title: Changes in Service Use Following the Introduction of AI-Enabled Prior Authorization in Medicare
items.excerpt: Using Epic Cosmos data, Neprash et al. assess changes in Medicare beneficiaries' use of medical services after AI-enabled prior authorization requirements began under the CMS Innovation Center WISeR model.

items.title: Does AI-Powered Clinical Documentation Enhance Clinician Efficiency? A Longitudinal Study
items.excerpt: Longitudinal study in NEJM AI tests whether AI-powered ambient clinical documentation actually improves clinician efficiency over time (Crossref created 2026-10-23).

items.title: UnitedHealthcare expands AI companion Avery to 21M members
items.excerpt: UnitedHealthcare is expanding Avery, its generative AI care-coordination companion, from about 6.6 million to 21 million members; the insurer says Avery resolves 90% of interactions and hands the rest to a human advocate.

items.title: 'AI 챗봇'으로 항암환자 PICC 관리 가정에서도 손쉽게
items.excerpt: 삼성서울병원 암병원이 항암치료 환자의 말초중심정맥관(PICC) 가정 관리를 돕는 카카오톡 AI 챗봇 서비스를 시작했다. 관을 넣은 채 수개월 생활하는 환자의 감염·막힘 위험 관리를 돕는다.

items.title: 재활의학회, 재활의 공공성·피지컬 AI 활용 방향 모색
items.excerpt: 대한재활의학회가 재활의료를 사회가 보장해야 할 필수 의료서비스로 보고, 피지컬 AI를 활용한 미래 재활의학의 방향을 논의했다.

items.title: Healthcare industry weighs in on evidence standards for generative AI medical devices
items.excerpt: FDA is weighing evidence standards for generative AI medical devices such as prescription bots; the AMA opposes upfront uncertainty while ATA Action supports post-market monitoring, and several groups back risk-based regulation.

items.title: FDA Official Believes GenAI-enabled Tools Will Need to Be Assessed Like a Physician - MedCity News

items.title: OpenEvidence's JAMA paper leaves open questions
items.excerpt: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: A new paper in JAMA offers a glimpse into clinicians's use of OpenEvidence, and a look at Isomorphic Labs.

items.title: Takeaways from an evaluation of Google's diagnostic chatbot, AMIE
items.excerpt: In this edition of STAT Health Tech: A look at a study recently published in The Lancet about Google's diagnostic chatbot, AMIE.
